summary: Coral provides a platform for managing online discussions and user comments on digital publications. Developed by Vox Media, it offers tools designed to improve community engagement and moderate user-generated content. The system runs on Node.js and is packaged via Docker containers.
goodFor: Publishers and site operators looking for a dedicated, self-hosted system to handle article comments and community moderation.
watchOut: Running a dedicated commenting platform introduces ongoing operational overhead, including database management, storage for user data, and routine software updates.
deployNotes: Deployment typically involves setting up a Docker container alongside a persistent database instance. You will also need to configure a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination and route incoming web traffic.
